d:
Button — triggers an action.
WHEN: Primary = the single main action in a view. Secondary = supporting actions (Cancel, Back). Ghost = low-emphasis, toolbar or inline actions. Tone=Danger = destructive or irreversible actions (Delete, Remove, Revoke), ideally confirmed in a dialog; never the default focused action.
PROPERTIES: Variant (Primary | Secondary | Ghost) · Tone (Default | Danger) · State (Default | Hover | Pressed | Focus | Disabled) · Size (Large 48 | Medium 40 | Small 32) · Label · Show/Leading icon · Show/Trailing icon.
TOKENS: button/* component tokens (primary, secondary, ghost, danger); button/radius → shape/radius-control.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Button variant="primary|secondary|ghost" tone="default|danger" size="lg|md|sm" />. v3.0 replaces the deprecated Button Danger.

Icon Button — a square button with only an icon (row actions, toolbars, close, overflow menus).
WHEN: The icon is universally understood (More, Close, Edit, Trash) and space is tight, e.g. per-row actions in lists. If the action needs words to be clear → Button with a label.
PROPERTIES: Variant (Primary | Secondary | Ghost) · Tone (Default | Danger) · State (Default | Hover | Pressed | Focus | Disabled) · Size (Large 48 | Medium 40 | Small 32) · Icon · Accessible label.
A11Y: Always set Accessible label to the action ("More actions for Jane Cooper"). Pair with a tooltip (v0.5). Target ≥24px in Compact.
TOKENS: same as Button; square size/control-*; icon size/icon-md (Medium) / size/icon-sm (Small).
CODE (@core-ds/react): <IconButton icon="more" label="More actions for Jane Cooper" variant="ghost|secondary|primary" size="md|sm" />

Link — navigates to another page or resource. Always underlined so it is identifiable without color.
WHEN: Navigation, inline references, "Learn more". Actions that change data → Button (Ghost if low emphasis).
PROPERTIES: State (Default | Hover | Focus) · Size (Medium = Body/Medium, Small = Body/Small) · Label · Show trailing icon · Trailing icon (default External Link for links that leave the product).
A11Y: Link text must make sense out of context (not "click here"). External links: show the icon and announce "opens in new tab" if applicable. Focus: 2px border/focus outline.
TOKENS: text/brand, text/brand-hover, border/focus, size/icon-sm, spacing/1.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Link href="…" size="md|sm" external>View billing history</Link>

Text Field — single-line text input with label and helper text.
WHEN: Short free-text entry (name, email, search query). For long text use a Textarea (v0.4); for choosing from options use Select (v0.4).
PROPERTIES: State (Default | Hover | Focus | Error | Disabled | Read-only) · Filled (False | True) · Label, Value, Helper text (text) · Show label, Show helper (boolean).
RULES: Always show a visible label — placeholder is never the label. In Error, replace helper text with how to fix it. Default width 320; stretch (fill) inside forms.
A11Y: In Disabled, the helper stays text/secondary so the reason it is disabled stays readable (v0.8 code audit). Border/strong meets 3:1. Error is communicated by text, not only color. Label is programmatically linked to the input.
TOKENS: bg/surface, border/strong|focus|danger|disabled, text/placeholder, radius/md, size/control-md, spacing/2-3.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <TextField label="Email" placeholder="…" helperText="…" error="…" leadingIcon="search" hideLabel disabled /> Size (Medium 40 | Small 32).
Dates → Date Field + Calendar (Date Picker); keep plain Text Fields for far-away dates people type, like birthdays.

Select — choose one option from a list (select-only combobox; no typing to filter).
WHEN: 5–15 mutually exclusive options. Fewer than 5 → Radio. Needs search/filter → Combobox. Multiple choices → Checkbox list.
PROPERTIES: State (Default | Hover | Focus | Error | Disabled | Read-only) · Filled (False | True) · Label, Value, Helper text · Show label, Show helper, Show leading icon · Leading icon (swap). Open state = field in Focus + "Select Menu" below it.
A11Y: In Disabled, the helper stays text/secondary so the reason it is disabled stays readable (v0.8 code audit). role=combobox + listbox. Enter/Space/↓ opens; ↑↓ move; Enter selects; Esc closes; typing jumps to matching option. Label always visible.
TOKENS: same as Text Field + chevron in color/icon/primary.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Select label="Time zone" placeholder="…" options={[{ value, label }]} error="…" /> (native <select>) Size (Medium 40 | Small 32).
Select Option — one row inside a Select Menu (listbox option). States: Default, Hover, Selected (brand-subtle + check), Disabled. Reused later by Menu (v0.5).
Select Menu — the open listbox shown under a focused Select (4px gap). Elevation/2, radius/md. Override option labels and states on the nested Select Option instances; add or remove rows as needed.

Combobox — a text field you can type into to filter a list, then pick one option (ARIA 1.2 combobox, list autocomplete).
WHEN: long or searchable lists (people, places, projects, 15+ options). 5–15 fixed options → Select. Fewer than 5 → Radio. Free text with no list → Text Field. Global search → Search Field.
PROPERTIES: State (Default | Focus | Error | Disabled | Hover | Read-only) · Filled (False | True) · Size (Medium 40 | Small 32) · Label, Value, Helper text · Show label, Show helper, Show leading icon · Leading icon (swap). Focus shows the caret; Filled shows the clear (×) button. Open state = field in Focus + "Combobox Menu" 4px below.
A11Y: role=combobox, aria-expanded, aria-controls → listbox, aria-activedescendant for the highlighted option, aria-autocomplete=list. Typing filters; ↓/↑ move; Enter selects; Esc closes then clears; Tab selects nothing and leaves. Announce result count via a polite live region.
TOKENS: same as Select + caret in bg/brand, clear in icon/secondary.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Combobox label="Assignee" options={people} onInputChange={search} loading={isLoading} onCreate={addPerson} />

Combobox Option — one row in the Combobox Menu. Same states as Select Option; Active = the option highlighted with the arrow keys (aria-activedescendant) — DOM focus stays in the input, so it gets a background + 2px brand bar, not a focus ring, Selected = the committed value (check).
Optional leading icon (swap) and a second line (Description) for people, places and records. Bold the characters that match the query using the Label text style.

Combobox Menu — the listbox that opens 4px under a focused Combobox. Content: Results (matches bolded; Focus = highlighted with arrow keys) · Recent (empty query) · Loading (async search, show after 300ms) · No results (say what was typed + what to try) · Create (offer to add the typed value). Show keyboard hint for first-run or power-user surfaces. Max height 320 then scroll; width = field width.

Date Field — type a date or open the Calendar from the calendar button. Pair with Calendar (popover, 4px below) to make a Date Picker.
WHEN: a specific day near today, where weekday context helps (due dates, bookings, report ranges). Birthdays and other far-away known dates → let people type (Date Field without the calendar, or three Text Fields). Relative periods (Last 7 days) → Segmented Control or Select presets.
PROPERTIES: State (Default | Focus | Error | Disabled | Hover | Read-only) · Filled (False | True) · Size (Medium 40 | Small 32) · Label, Value, Helper text · Show label, Show helper, Show leading icon · Leading icon (swap). Range: same field, Value "Nov 16 – Nov 21, 2026", placeholder "Start – end date".
FORMAT: always show the format in the helper (mm/dd/yyyy) and accept typing; parse loosely (11/18, Nov 18), display unambiguously (Nov 18, 2026).
A11Y: input stays typeable; the calendar button is a separate button with aria-label "Choose date, selected Nov 18, 2026" and opens a dialog. Errors explain the rule ("Pick a date after today").
TOKENS: same as Select; calendar icon in icon/secondary.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <DatePicker label="Due date" value={date} onChange={setDate} min={today} />

Calendar Day — one cell of the Calendar grid (40×40 hit area, 32px circle).
STATES: Default · Hover · Focus (keyboard, Focus/Ring) · Today (brand ring + brand text, aria-current="date") · Selected (bg/brand) · Range start / In range / Range end (bg/brand-subtle band) · Outside month (text/secondary, still selectable) · Disabled (text/disabled + a drawn strike line — not colour alone; aria-disabled).
Day = the number. Use inside Calendar; don't place on its own.

Calendar — month grid that opens in a popover under Date Field (Date Picker), or sits inline on booking pages.
Mode: Single (Clear · Today footer) | Range (summary · Cancel · Apply footer). Month = header text. Show footer off for inline calendars that apply on click.
GRID: 7 columns × 6 rows always (height never jumps). Week starts Sunday (en-PH, en-US); start Monday for locales that do. Outside-month days stay selectable. Override a day with the Day property on any cell.
A11Y (WAI-ARIA APG Date Picker Dialog): role="dialog" aria-modal + aria-label "Choose date"; grid role="grid"; selected aria-selected; today aria-current="date". ←→ day · ↑↓ week · Home/End start/end of week · PageUp/PageDown month · Shift+PageUp/PageDown year · Enter/Space select · Esc closes and returns focus to the calendar button.
TOKENS: bg/surface-raised · border/default · Elevation/2 · radius/lg · bg/brand (selected) · bg/brand-subtle (range) · text/brand (today) · text/disabled + strikethrough.

Textarea — multi-line free text (comments, descriptions, feedback).
WHEN: Answers longer than one line. Single-line values → Text Field.
PROPERTIES: State (Default | Hover | Focus | Error | Disabled | Read-only) · Filled (False | True) · Label, Value, Helper text, Counter · Show label, Show helper, Show counter. The field grows with content from a minimum height (size/textarea-min).
A11Y: In Disabled, the helper stays text/secondary so the reason it is disabled stays readable (v0.8 code audit). Visible label; helper/error and counter linked via aria-describedby; announce the limit, not every keystroke.
TOKENS: same as Text Field + size/textarea-min, spacing/2 vertical padding.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Textarea label="Bio" showCounter maxLength={160} helperText="…" error="…" />

Search Field — single-line search with a search icon and clear button.
WHEN: header search, table toolbars, list filters. For picking one value from a long list use Combobox.
PROPERTIES: State (Default | Hover | Focus | Disabled) · Filled (False | True — shows the clear button) · Size (Medium 40 | Small 32) · Value.
TOKENS: field/bg, field/border, field/radius → shape/radius-control, border/hover, border/focus, icon/secondary.
A11Y: role="searchbox", label "Search <thing>", clear button label "Clear search".
CODE (@core-ds/react): <SearchField size="md|sm" onClear={…} />

Checkbox — select zero, one or many independent options.
WHEN: Multiple selection or a single opt-in applied on submit. Use Radio (v0.4) for mutually exclusive choices and Toggle (v0.4) for instant on/off settings.
PROPERTIES: Checked (False | True | Indeterminate) · State (Default | Hover | Focus | Error | Disabled) · Label (text) · Show label (boolean).
RULES: Indeterminate only for a parent whose children are partially selected. Whole row is the click target.
A11Y: Unchecked border ≥3:1. State shown by icon, not color alone. Space toggles.
TOKENS: bg/surface, bg/brand, border/strong, icon/on-color, radius/sm, size/icon-md.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Checkbox label="Email" defaultChecked | indeterminate | disabled />

Radio — pick exactly one option from a small, visible set (2–5). Always used in a group with a visible group label.
WHEN: Mutually exclusive choices that benefit from being seen at once. More than ~5 options → Select. Independent choices → Checkbox. Instant on/off → Toggle.
PROPERTIES: Checked (False | True) · State (Default | Hover | Focus | Error | Disabled) · Label · Show label.
A11Y: radiogroup with an accessible name. Tab enters the group on the selected radio; arrow keys move focus and select; Space selects. State shown by the dot, not color alone.
TOKENS: bg/surface, bg/brand, border/strong, icon/on-color, radius/full, size/icon-md, gap/inline.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <RadioGroup label="Billing cycle" name="cycle" options={[…]} defaultValue="m" />  ·  single: <Radio label="…" />

Toggle — switch a single setting on or off with immediate effect (role=switch).
WHEN: Settings that apply instantly (e.g. "Email notifications"). If the change only applies on Save/Submit → Checkbox. Choosing between options → Radio.
PROPERTIES: Checked (False | True) · State (Default | Focus | Disabled) · Label · Show label.
A11Y: role=switch with aria-checked; Space toggles (Enter optional). The label describes the setting, not the state ("Wi-Fi", not "Turn Wi-Fi on"). Off track uses color/bg/control-off (≥3:1 against surface).
TOKENS: bg/control-off, bg/brand, icon/on-color, size/toggle-width/height (density-aware), radius/full.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Toggle label="Email notifications" defaultChecked onChange={(on) => …} />

Slider — pick a value (Single) or a range (Range) on a continuous scale where the exact number matters less than the position: volume, price filters, zoom.
WHEN: approximate values within known bounds. Exact numbers → Text Field (number) — or turn on Show input. Few discrete choices → Segmented Control / Radio.
PROPERTIES: Type (Single | Range) · State (Default | Disabled) · Label · Value (formatted, e.g. "₱2,000 – ₱8,000") · Show header · Show min/max · Show input (numeric fields synced with the thumbs). Thumbs are exposed: set Hover/Focus/Pressed from the parent. Move a thumb by nudging its x; the fill is a separate layer.
A11Y: each thumb role="slider" with aria-valuemin/max/now + aria-valuetext ("₱2,000"); Range thumbs get aria-label "Minimum price" / "Maximum price". ←↓ −1 step, →↑ +1, PgUp/PgDn ±10%, Home/End min/max. WCAG 2.5.7: dragging is never required — click the track or type in the input. Thumb hit area 40px.
TOKENS: rail bg/control-off · fill bg/brand · thumb bg/surface + 2px bg/brand · disabled bg/disabled + icon/disabled.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Slider label="Volume" value={v} onChange={setV} min={0} max={100} /> · <RangeSlider label="Price" value={[2000, 8000]} min={0} max={10000} step={500} format={peso} showInputs />

Slider Thumb — the handle. 20px visual, 40px hit area in code.
STATES: Default · Hover (Elevation/1) · Focus (Focus/Ring) · Pressed (6px bg/brand-subtle halo while dragging) · Disabled. Use inside Slider.

Chip — compact selectable token for filters and tags.
WHEN: filter bars, multi-select choices, removable tags. Not for actions (use Button) or status (use Badge).
PROPERTIES: Selected (False | True) · State (Default | Hover | Focus | Disabled) · Label · Removable.
TOKENS: bg/surface, bg/selected, border/strong, border/selected, text/brand; radius/full; size/control-sm.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Chip selected onRemove={…}>Label</Chip>

File Upload — drop zone for attaching files.
WHEN: forms that need documents or images. State the accepted types and size limit in Helper text. List uploads below with Progress Bar + a remove Icon Button.
PROPERTIES: State (Default | Hover | Dragging | Error | Disabled) · Helper text.
TOKENS: border/strong (dashed), border/focus while dragging, bg/selected, bg/danger-subtle + text/danger for errors, shape/radius-container.
A11Y: the whole zone is a labelled button that opens the file picker; announce upload progress and errors.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <FileUpload accept=".pdf,.png,.jpg" maxSize="10MB" onFiles={…} />
props: PDF, PNG or JPG, up to 10 MB

d:
Alert — an inline, persistent message about the page or a section (also called banner or callout).
WHEN: Information the user must notice and may need to act on: errors that block progress, warnings, important status. Stays until resolved or dismissed. Brief confirmation of an action → Toast. Field-level errors → the field's Error state.
PROPERTIES: Tone (Info | Success | Warning | Danger) · Title, Description · Show title, Show action (nested Link, exposed), Show close (Icon Button "Close").
A11Y: Static alerts are plain content. If inserted dynamically: Danger uses role=alert (assertive); others role=status (polite). The icon is decorative — the title carries the meaning. Never rely on tone color alone.
TOKENS: bg/{brand,success,warning,danger}-subtle, matching text/* for the icon, text/primary + text/secondary, padding/row, radius/md.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Alert tone="info|success|warning|danger" title="…" action={<Link …/>} onDismiss={…} live>Description</Alert>
props: Short explanation of what happened and what to do next.

d:
Toast — a brief, non-blocking confirmation that appears in a corner (bottom-right or bottom-center) and goes away.
WHEN: Confirming an action the user just took ("Invitation sent", "Link copied"), optionally with Undo. Anything the user must notice or act on → Alert or Dialog.
PROPERTIES: Tone (Neutral | Success | Danger | Warning | Info) · Message · Show action (nested Ghost Button, exposed, e.g. "Undo") · Show close.
BEHAVIOUR: Auto-dismiss after ≥5 s; hover or focus pauses the timer (WCAG 2.2.1). Danger toasts and toasts with an action do NOT auto-dismiss. Stack max 3, newest on top. Enter: duration/moderate + easing/enter; exit: duration/fast + easing/exit; Reduced = no slide.
A11Y: Render inside one persistent live region: role=status (polite) for Neutral/Success, role=alert for Danger. Don't move focus to the toast. Never the only evidence that something happened.
TOKENS: bg/surface, border/default, Elevation/3, radius/md, padding/row, icon colors text/success|danger, icon/primary.
CODE (@core-ds/react): const toast = useToast(); toast.show({ message: "…", tone: "neutral|success|danger", action: { label: "Undo", onClick } })  — wrap the app in <ToastProvider>

Progress Bar — determinate progress.
WHEN: uploads, multi-step setup, storage or quota use. Unknown duration → Spinner / Skeleton.
PROPERTIES: Tone (Brand | Success | Warning | Danger) · Size (Medium 8px | Small 4px) · Label · Value · Show label. Resize "indicator" to the percentage.
TOKENS: bg/neutral-pressed track; bg/brand, bg/success, bg/warning, bg/danger indicator; radius/full.
A11Y: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/min/max and a visible or aria label.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Progress value={60} tone="brand" size="md" label="Uploading files" />

Skeleton — a placeholder that mirrors the shape of content while it loads.
WHEN: Loading content whose layout is known (lists, cards, profiles) and takes longer than ~300ms. Unknown layout or short actions → Spinner.
PROPERTIES: Shape (Text — resize width to the expected line length; Circle — avatar; Block — images/cards). Compose skeleton rows that match the real layout exactly.
MOTION: Optional shimmer/pulse with duration/slow + easing/standard, looping; Reduced = static.
A11Y: Mark the loading region aria-busy=true and announce completion via a polite status message; skeletons are hidden from assistive tech.
TOKENS: bg/surface-subtle, radius/sm | full | md, size/avatar-lg.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Skeleton shape="text|circle|block" width={…} />

Spinner — indicates that something is in progress when its duration and shape are unknown.
WHEN: Short waits (< ~2 s) for an action or a small region; inside buttons for "Saving…". Known layout → Skeleton. Long tasks → progress with text (planned).
PROPERTIES: Size (Small 16 — inline/buttons · Medium 20 — inputs, small regions · Large 32 — panels).
MOTION: Rotate 360° with a 1s linear loop; Reduced = slow (≥2s) rotation or a static indicator plus text.
A11Y: Provide text ("Loading members…") via aria-label or visible label; set aria-busy on the region; don't announce repeatedly.
TOKENS: border/default track, bg/brand indicator, size/icon-sm | icon-md | control-sm.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Spinner size="sm|md|lg" label="Loading members" />

Empty State — explains why a space is empty and what to do next.
WHEN: First use (nothing created yet), no search/filter results, or cleared lists. Errors that prevent loading → Alert. While loading → Skeleton/Spinner (never show an empty state before data arrives).
PROPERTIES: Icon (swap) · Title · Description · Show actions · Show secondary action. Actions are exposed Button instances. · Media (slot: custom illustration or image) · Show icon (turn off when using Media)
WRITING: Title says what's missing ("No members yet" / "No results for “wade”"); description says how to fill it; the primary action does exactly that. For no-results, offer "Clear filters" instead of a create action.
TOKENS: bg/surface-subtle circle (size/control-lg), icon/primary, Heading/H4, Body/Small, gap/stack, spacing/10 vertical padding.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <EmptyState icon="user" title="…" description="…" actions={<Button …/>} headingLevel={2} />
props: Invite people to collaborate on projects in this workspace.

d:
Tooltip — a short text label that appears on hover or keyboard focus of a control.
WHEN: Naming Icon Buttons ("Edit", "More actions") and clarifying truncated text. Not for essential information, rich content or actions — use inline text, Alert or a popover.
PROPERTIES: Placement (Top | Bottom | Left | Right — side of the target the tooltip sits on) · Text (≤ 1 short line; wraps at 240px).
BEHAVIOUR: Show on hover after ~duration/moderate delay and immediately on focus; hide on blur, pointer leave or Esc. Must stay visible while the pointer is over it (WCAG 1.4.13). Enter with duration/fast + easing/enter.
A11Y: role=tooltip, referenced by aria-describedby (or provides the name of an icon-only button). Never put interactive elements inside.
TOKENS: bg/inverse, text/inverse, Body/Small, radius/md, spacing/2 × spacing/3.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Tooltip content="Edit member" placement="top|bottom|left|right"><IconButton … /></Tooltip>

Badge — short, non-interactive status or category label (1–2 words).
WHEN: Show status (Active, Pending), category or "New". Not clickable — use Button for actions.
PROPERTIES: Tone (Neutral | Brand | Success | Warning | Danger | Info) · Label (text).
RULES: Same status = same tone everywhere. Danger only for critical states.
A11Y: Meaning carried by the label text, not color alone.
TOKENS: bg/*-subtle with matching text/*, radius/full, spacing/0-5 and spacing/2.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Badge tone="neutral|brand|success|warning|danger">Active</Badge>

Dialog — a modal window that interrupts the page for a decision or a short focused task.
WHEN: Confirming destructive/irreversible actions (Tone=Danger), or short tasks that must finish before continuing (invite, rename). Long or multi-step work → a page. Non-blocking messages → Alert/Toast.
PROPERTIES: Size (Small 400 | Medium 560) · Tone (Default | Danger — Danger uses Button Danger) · Title · Description · Show close · Show secondary action. Footer buttons are exposed instances (edit labels from the dialog). Put form fields in the "Content" slot (v1.1).
BEHAVIOUR: Open over color/bg/overlay scrim. Enter: duration/slow + easing/enter (fade + 8px rise); exit: duration/moderate + easing/exit; Reduced = fade only.
A11Y (APG Dialog): role=dialog + aria-modal=true, labelled by the title, described by the description. On open, focus moves inside (first field, or Cancel for Danger); Tab/Shift+Tab stay inside; Esc closes; on close focus returns to the trigger. The page behind is inert.
TOKENS: bg/surface, bg/overlay, Elevation/3, radius/xl, padding/card, gap/stack, gap/inline, Heading/H3, Body/Medium.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Dialog open onClose={…} title="…" description="…" size="sm|md" tone="default|danger" footer={<>…</>} /> (native <dialog>)

Popover — small floating panel anchored to a trigger.
WHEN: extra detail, a short form or a few options next to the trigger. Not for menus of actions (use Menu) or blocking decisions (use Dialog).
PROPERTIES: Title · Show title · Description · Content (slot) · Show content.
TOKENS: bg/surface-raised, border/default, shape/radius-container, Elevation/2, spacing/4; layer z/dropdown.
A11Y: aria-haspopup="dialog" on the trigger; focus moves into the popover; Escape closes and returns focus.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Popover trigger={…} title="…">…</Popover>
props: Invoices and payment reminders go to this address.

d:
Drawer — full-height side panel over the page.
WHEN: record details, filters, multi-field edits that keep the page in context. Short confirmations → Dialog; small details → Popover.
PROPERTIES: Title · Content (slot) · Show footer (primary + secondary actions). Width 400 (Desktop/Tablet), full width on Mobile.
TOKENS: bg/surface-raised, Elevation/3, border/default dividers, spacing/6 padding; scrim color/bg/overlay; layer z/modal.
A11Y: role="dialog", aria-modal, focus trapped, Escape and the close button dismiss.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Drawer open title="Filters" footer={…}>…</Drawer>

Menu Item — one action inside a Menu.
PROPERTIES: Tone (Default | Danger) · State (Default | Hover | Disabled | Focus) · Label · Show icon + Icon (swap) · Show shortcut + Shortcut. Hover also represents keyboard focus (menus use a moving highlight, not a focus ring).
RULES: Labels stay on one line (truncate with …; keep them short so they never need to). Labels are verbs ("Edit role", "Remove from workspace"). Danger items go last, after a Divider. Use icons on all items in a menu or none.
CODE (@core-ds/react): Menu item: { label: "Edit role", icon: "edit", tone: "default|danger", disabled }

Menu — a list of actions that opens from a trigger (usually an Icon Button "More" or a Button with a Chevron Down).
WHEN: Secondary actions on an object or page. Choosing a value → Select. Navigation → Link list / navigation (v0.6).
SIZE: 280 default (min 200, max 320); items never wrap.
STRUCTURE: Menu Item instances, Divider between groups, Danger items last. Override labels/icons on nested items; add or remove rows.
BEHAVIOUR: Opens below the trigger (flip if no room) with duration/moderate + easing/enter. Closes on selection, Esc or outside click.
A11Y (APG Menu Button): trigger has aria-haspopup=menu + aria-expanded; Enter/Space/↓ open with focus on the first item; ↑↓ move, Home/End jump, typing a letter jumps; Enter activates; Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger. role=menu / menuitem; Divider = role=separator.
TOKENS: bg/surface-raised, border/default, Elevation/2, radius/md, spacing/1.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Menu label="More actions for Esther Howard" items={[{ label, icon, tone: "danger", separatorBefore }]} />

Nav Item — one destination in the Sidebar.
PROPERTIES: State (Default | Hover | Selected | Focus) · Collapsed (False = icon + label | True = 40px icon only, for the tablet rail) · Label · Icon (swap) · Show count (nested Badge, expanded only).
A11Y: It is a link. The current page has aria-current="page" (= Selected). Collapsed items keep the label as accessible name and show it in a Tooltip on hover/focus. Focus uses the standard Focus/Ring.
CODE (@core-ds/react): Nav item: { label, href, icon, count, current } inside <Sidebar items={…} />

Sidebar — primary app navigation, used together with the App Header.
VARIANTS: Expanded (Desktop, 256px, icon + label) · Rail (Tablet, 72px, icons only — labels in Tooltips) · Drawer (Mobile, 288px, opens from the header Menu button over color/bg/overlay, with Close). Width comes from layout/sidebar-width; each variant pins its Layout mode.
STRUCTURE: nav (Nav Item instances; override labels, icons, Selected) → Divider → account row (Avatar + name).
A11Y: <nav aria-label="Main">. Drawer behaves like a modal dialog (focus trapped, Esc closes, focus returns to the Menu button). Desktop users can collapse Expanded → Rail with the header Menu button (aria-expanded).
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Sidebar items={[{ label, href, icon, count, current }]} variant="expanded|rail" />

Skip Link — first focusable element on every page (WCAG 2.4.1). Hidden until it receives keyboard focus, then appears top-left above the App Header; Enter moves focus to <main>. Shown here in its focused state.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <SkipLink href="#main" />

App Header — the top bar of every app screen. Height = layout/header-height (64 Desktop / 56 Tablet+Mobile).
LAYOUTS: Desktop (Menu button collapses the Sidebar to a rail · brand · search · notifications · account) · Desktop with nav (header-only pattern: brand + top nav links, no sidebar) · Mobile (Menu opens the Sidebar Drawer · brand · search icon · account).
PROPERTIES: Layout · Product name. Replace the logo-mark with your logo; nested instances are editable. · Actions (slot: extra header actions such as a help menu, language or theme switch)
A11Y: <header role="banner">. Skip Link comes before it. Top nav links use Tab visuals but link semantics (aria-current="page"), not role=tab. Menu button has aria-expanded + aria-controls.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <AppHeader productName="Acme" userName="Jane Cooper" onMenuClick={…} onSearch={…} />

Breadcrumbs — shows where the page sits in the hierarchy. Up to 2 ancestor Links (exposed) + the current page (plain text, aria-current="page"). <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">. Hide on Mobile when the back path is obvious; never more than 4 levels.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Breadcrumbs items={[{ label: "Settings", href }, { label: "Members" }]} />

Page Header — the top block of a page's content area: optional Breadcrumbs, title (the page's only H1 in code), description and page-level actions.
LAYOUTS: Horizontal (Desktop/Tablet: text left, actions right) · Stacked (Mobile: actions below, full width; title uses Heading/H3).
PROPERTIES: Title, Description, Show breadcrumbs/description/secondary/primary action. Actions are exposed Buttons. · Extra actions (slot: filters, view toggles, export menu)
RULES: Max one Primary action. Put filters and tabs below the Page Header, not inside it.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <PageHeader title="…" description="…" breadcrumbs={<Breadcrumbs …/>} actions={<>…</>} />
props: Manage who can access the Acme workspace and what they can do.

d:
Tab — one item in a Tabs bar. Selected tabs use color/text/brand with a 2px brand indicator; unselected use text/secondary.
PROPERTIES: Selected (False | True) · State (Default | Hover | Focus | Disabled) · Label · Show count (nested Badge, exposed).
CODE (@core-ds/react): Tab: { id, label, count, disabled, panel } inside <Tabs tabs={…} /> Show icon + Icon: optional leading icon that takes the label color.
Switching how the same content is shown (no separate panels) → Segmented Control.

Tabs — switch between related views of the same content without leaving the page.
WHEN: 2–6 peer views (Members / Invites / Roles). Sequential steps → a stepper (planned). Navigation between pages → navigation (v0.6). Filtering a list → Select or chips.
STRUCTURE: Tab instances in a tablist over a Divider baseline. Override labels/selection on nested tabs; add or remove tabs.
A11Y (APG Tabs): role=tablist / tab / tabpanel; only the selected tab is in the Tab order; ←/→ move between tabs (Home/End jump). Automatic activation (panel switches on arrow) when panels are instant; manual activation (Enter/Space) when panels load slowly.
MOTION: indicator slides with duration/moderate + easing/standard; Reduced = no slide.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Tabs label="Member views" tabs={[{ id, label, count, panel }]} />
Switching how the same content is shown (no separate panels) → Segmented Control.

Segmented Control — pick one of 2–5 related options that change how the same content is shown (view, period, filter). Selection applies immediately.
WHEN: 2–5 short, mutually exclusive options; switch views (List | Board), periods (Day | Week | Month) or filters (All | Open | Closed). More than 5 or long labels → Select. Separate content panels → Tabs. Choice submitted with a form → Radio. On/off → Toggle. Actions → Buttons.
PROPERTIES: Items (2–5) · Size (Medium 40 | Small 32). Each segment is exposed: set Selected, Label, Show icon, Icon, Show label from the parent. Segments are equal width — resize the control or set it to Fill for full width.
A11Y: role=radiogroup + aria-label; segments role=radio + aria-checked. Tab enters on the selected segment; ←/→ move and select; Home/End jump. If it swaps panels, use the Tabs pattern (tablist/tab) instead. Icon-only segments need aria-label + Tooltip. Small segments are 24px tall (WCAG 2.5.8 minimum).
TOKENS: track bg/surface-subtle + border/default · selected bg/surface-raised + border/default + Elevation/1 · text/secondary → text/primary · radius 8 outer / 4 inner · size/control-md|sm.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <SegmentedControl aria-label="View" value={view} onChange={setView} options={[{ value: 'list', label: 'List' }, …]} size="md" />

Segmented Control Item — one segment. Use inside Segmented Control; don't place on its own.
PROPERTIES: Selected (False | True) · State (Default | Hover | Focus | Disabled) · Size (Medium 32 | Small 24) · Label · Show label · Show icon · Icon (swap). Icon-only = Show label off + accessible name in code + Tooltip.
SELECTED = bg/surface-raised + border/default + Elevation/1 (not colour alone). Focus = Focus/Ring.

Stepper — shows where someone is in a linear, multi-step flow (onboarding, checkout, setup) and lets them go back to finished steps.
WHEN: 3–7 steps that must happen in order. 2 steps → Back/Next buttons. Independent sections → Tabs. System progress → Progress. One long form → Form Section.
PROPERTIES: Steps (3 | 4 | 5) · Orientation (Horizontal for desktop page tops | Vertical for side panels and mobile). Each step is exposed: set State, Label, Description, Number.
A11Y: <nav aria-label="Progress"><ol>; current step aria-current="step"; completed steps are links ("Step 1, Account, completed"); errors in text. Mobile: collapse to "Step 2 of 5 · Company".
TOKENS: bg/brand + icon/on-color (complete) · border/focus-brand ring (current) · border/strong (upcoming) · bg/danger-subtle + text/danger (error) · connector border/default → bg/brand.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Stepper current={1} steps={[{ label: 'Account', description: '…', status: 'complete' }, …]} onStepClick={goTo} />

Step — one step of a Stepper. Use inside Stepper.
STATES: Complete (bg/brand + check) · Current (brand ring + number, aria-current="step") · Upcoming (border/strong + number) · Error (danger ring + alert icon, description says what to fix). Status is shown by icon + text, never colour alone.
PROPERTIES: State · Orientation (Horizontal | Vertical) · Label · Description · Show description · Number · Show connector (turn off on the last step).

Accordion Item — one collapsible section.
WHEN: FAQs, grouped settings, long forms where users need only some sections. Not for navigation (use Tabs) or primary content that everyone needs.
PROPERTIES: Expanded (False | True) · State (Default | Hover | Focus) · Title · Description · Content (slot, expanded only).
TOKENS: border/default divider, bg/neutral-hover, text/primary, text/secondary, icon/secondary; spacing/4 padding.
A11Y: header is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Accordion><Accordion.Item title="…">…</Accordion.Item></Accordion>
props: What is included in the plan?
Every plan includes unlimited projects, 10 GB of storage per member and email support.

d:
Avatar — represents a person or workspace.
WHEN: Next to names in lists, comments, headers and account menus. Use Type=Initials when a name is known, Type=Icon as the fallback. For photos, add an image fill to the avatar frame on the instance (initials stay as fallback).
PROPERTIES: Size (Small 24 | Medium 32 | Large 40) · Type (Initials | Icon | Image — replace the "image" layer fill with a photo) · Initials (text, 1–2 characters).
A11Y: Decorative when the name is shown beside it (alt=""); otherwise the accessible name is the person's name, not the initials.
TOKENS: size/avatar-sm|md|lg, radius/full, bg/brand-subtle, text/brand.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Avatar name="Jane Cooper" size="sm|md|lg" decorative /> Show status: presence dot (success color; recolor the "status" layer for away/busy).

Card — container grouping content and up to two actions about one subject.
WHEN: Flat (border only) inside other surfaces, lists and dense grids. Raised (Elevation/2) when the card sits directly on the canvas or needs emphasis.
PROPERTIES: Elevation (Flat | Raised) · Title, Body (text) · Show actions (boolean). Contains nested Button instances (Primary + Secondary) that can be overridden. · Media (slot: image, chart, illustration) · Content (slot: lists, key–value rows, fields)
RULES: One topic per card. Don't nest cards. Don't mix Flat and Raised in one list. Default width 360; stretch in grids.
TOKENS: bg/surface, border/default, radius/lg, spacing/6 padding, spacing/4 gap, Heading/H4 + Body/Small.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Card title="…" elevation="flat|raised" actions={<>…</>}>Body</Card>
props: Supporting text that explains the content of this card in one or two short sentences.

d:
Divider — a 1px rule that separates groups of content.
WHEN: Between sections of a list, card or menu when spacing alone is not enough. Prefer whitespace (gap/stack, spacing/*) first.
PROPERTIES: Orientation (Horizontal | Vertical). In auto layout set Horizontal to Fill width, Vertical to Fill height.
A11Y: Decorative by default (no role). Use role=separator only when it separates meaningful groups (e.g. in menus).
TOKENS: border/default fill, border-width/default thickness.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Divider orientation="horizontal|vertical" />

List Item — one row in a simple list (members, files, notifications). Replaces hand-built rows from the v0.4.1 agent test.
PROPERTIES: State (Default | Hover | Selected | Focus) · Title, Description · Show leading (Avatar, exposed — swap for an icon if needed) · Show meta (Badge, exposed) · Show action (Icon Button, exposed; set Accessible label per row). · Trailing (slot: badge, toggle, price, custom controls)
TEXT: title and description wrap (never clip); keep descriptions to one sentence.
LAYOUT: Stack items with a Divider between them inside a bg/surface + border/default + radius/lg container. Padding padding/card × padding/row (density-aware). Need columns, sorting or comparison → Table.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <List label="…"><ListItem title="…" description="…" leading={<Avatar …/>} meta={<Badge …/>} action={<Menu …/>} /></List>

Table Header Cell — column header. Sort: None (sortable, unsorted) · Ascending · Descending · Not sortable.
A11Y: <th scope="col"> with aria-sort on the sorted column only; the label is a button that toggles sort. Resize width to the column; use the same width for every cell in that column.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Table columns={[{ key, header, sortable, render }]} sort={{ key, direction }} … />  (header cell)

Table Cell — one cell in a data table row. Types: Text · Two-line · Avatar (person) · Badge (status) · Numeric (right-aligned, tabular) · Checkbox (row selection, 48px) · Actions (Icon Button "More", 64px).
COMPOSE A TABLE: a header row of Table Header Cells, then rows = horizontal auto-layout frames of Table Cells with matching widths (fill the flexible column) and EVERY body cell set to Fill height, so bottom borders line up (header cells keep their fixed size/control-md height). Row hover = color/bg/neutral-hover; selected row = color/bg/brand-subtle. Wrap in bg/surface + border/default + radius/lg, clip content.
A11Y: real <table> with a caption/accessible name; checkbox cells label "Select <row name>"; action Icon Buttons include the row name ("More actions for Jane Cooper"). On Mobile, switch a table to List Items unless columns are essential.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Table caption="…" columns={[…]} rows={…} rowKey={…} />  (cells via column render)

Pagination — moves through pages of a table or list. Summary text (what is shown) + previous/next Icon Buttons (Secondary, Small; Disabled at the ends) + current page. <nav aria-label="Table pagination">; announce the new range in a polite status message after paging.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <Pagination page={1} pageCount={5} summary="Showing 1–10 of 48" onPageChange={…} />

Form Section — groups related fields under a title and description inside long forms and settings pages.
LAYOUTS: Side by side (Desktop/Tablet: intro column 340px + fields filling the rest, gap = layout/gutter) · Stacked (Mobile).
CONTENT: the "fields" frame holds placeholder fields — replace with any inputs (Text Field, Select, Textarea, Radio group, Toggle…), keep gap/stack between them. Sections are separated by a top border and layout/section-gap padding.
A11Y: each section is a <fieldset> (or region) with the title as its <legend>/heading.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <FormSection title="…" description="…">{fields}</FormSection>
props: This information is visible to everyone in the workspace.

d:
Error Summary — shown at the top of a form after a failed submit when there is more than one error.
CONTENT: title states how many problems; each error is a Link (exposed) with the same text as the field's error message, pointing to that field (href="#field-id"). Add/remove links as needed.
BEHAVIOUR: On submit with errors, render it, move focus to it (tabindex=-1), and also show each field's Error state. Remove when all errors are fixed. Single error on a short form → just focus the field.
A11Y: role=alert or focus on render; links move focus to the field. Never rely on red alone — the icon + title carry the meaning.
TOKENS: bg/danger-subtle, border/danger (strong), text/danger icon, Label/Large, Link Small.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <ErrorSummary errors={[{ fieldId: "email", message: "…" }]} />
props: There are 2 problems with your form

d:
Form Actions — the buttons that submit or cancel a form.
VARIANTS: Inline (end of a short form, after the last section) · Sticky (long settings pages: pinned to the bottom of the viewport, appears when there are unsaved changes; surface-raised + Elevation/2).
RULES: Primary (save/submit) on the right, Cancel to its left. On Mobile, buttons fill the width (Primary on top). Disable nothing — validate on submit and show the Error Summary.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <FormActions variant="inline|sticky" status="You have unsaved changes" onCancel={…} />

AI Response — an answer written by AI, with its disclosure, sources and controls.
STATES: Streaming (cursor + Stop) · Complete (sources, confidence, Copy · Regenerate · Edit, feedback) · Stopped (partial answer kept, labelled) · Error (Alert explains what happened; Try again).
RULES: always show the AI Label; cite sources under the claim; let people stop, edit and undo; show confidence only when it's real.
A11Y: container aria-live="polite" aria-busy while streaming; announce by sentence, not by token; Stop is the first focusable control; icon buttons have names.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <AIResponse status="complete" sources={[…]} confidence="high" onRegenerate={…} onFeedback={…}>{text}</AIResponse>

AI Label — discloses that content was made or changed by AI. Generated (accent) | Edited (neutral, after a person edits it). Always visible on AI output; never hidden in a tooltip. Code: <AILabel type="generated" />
Citation — a numbered source behind an AI answer. A link: opens the source, with an accessible name like "Source 1: Leave policy 2026". Put them right under the claim they support.
AI Confidence — how sure the system is, in words + icon (never colour alone). High (sources agree) · Medium (partial support) · Low (check before using). Only show when the model gives a real signal.

PRODUCT KIT (SaaS admin) — not Core. Stat Card — one key number on a dashboard.
PROPERTIES: Trend (Positive | Negative | Neutral — sets the Badge tone) · Label · Value · Context · Show trend.
RULES: Label says what is counted; value uses Heading/H2 with tabular figures; the trend Badge always shows a sign (+/−) so meaning doesn't rely on color; context says the comparison period. Lay out 4 per row on Desktop (3 columns each), 2 on Tablet, 1–2 on Mobile.
CODE (@core-ds/react): <StatCard label="Active members" value="1,284" trend={{ direction: "positive", value: "+12%" }} context="vs. last 30 days" />
